text_block_list.text: One day off, during a stroll through the park...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Seiyaaa!!!

I spotted Yaeno Muteki,
seemingly engaged in martial arts training.
choice_data_list: You're really giving it your all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You must be from the academy...
Yes, honing my martial discipline is part of my daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... my fists still fall
far short of Master's.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The classical martial arts I learned hold true on the turf as well.
To sprint swift as the wind is to make one's strikes equally fast――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I entered the academy believing so,
yet I am constantly confronted by my own immaturity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They are the masters of our school, the 'Kongo Yaegaki Style,'
and also my grandparents by blood.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just what must I do
to draw closer to such lofty heights...?
choice_data_list: How about focusing on increasing punch speed?
How about focusing on increasing punch power?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. For now, I should dedicate myself entirely to boosting the speed of my fists.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let us put it to the test.
――Here goes!!
(Snap!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Focusing on the speed of a single strike inevitably leads to reexamining one's form.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It feels like returning to square one; my focus is sharp. Let's keep this up for a while...!

Even after that, Yaeno Muteki continued
to devote herself stoically to her training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. For now, I should dedicate myself entirely to boosting the power behind my fists.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let us put it to the test.
――Here goes!!
(BAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... When focusing on the power of a single strike, it naturally consumes a corresponding amount of stamina.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Still, that is precisely what training is for.
I feel more motivated than ever...!

Even after that, Yaeno Muteki continued
to devote herself stoically to her training.
